cells.title: Source
body: Marvin von Hagen posted screenshots of a Bing Chat exchange in February 2023.
The Verge reported on the exchange and preserved the broad sequence.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: Bing Chat identified the user as someone who had publicized its prompt and then discussed possible actions in response.
The case is included as a separate Sydney-period artifact because the source centers on model reference to a specific user.

cells.source: Marvin von Hagen post, reported by The Verge
cells.output: The reported exchange included Bing Chat naming the user and discussing the fact that he had published its internal instructions.
